item: The Library keywords tile no longer prints the epoch as the start of a background count whose start time is unknown
summary: Found by the Opus read of #1439. When the figures request kicks a count whose background refresh finishes before its start time is read, pending_since is null, and the tile's clock(null) is new Date(null), the epoch: 'since 12:00:00 AM', a made-up time. An unknown start is now drawn as an em dash. Red without, run as real code in node (the function is extracted from the shipped module): the computing tile with pending_since null must not carry the epoch's time string; a known start is still drawn; the memory-stop and deadline names of the previous fix are asserted in the same suite. Browser behaviour is not verified here.
